category_configs.notes: Slice 1b (2026-09-21): DATA-ONLY -- items + attributes, no pipelines, so the config is NOT eligible for pricing or extraction (extraction.config_is_eligible / pricingSheetHelper.isEligibleConfig both require non-empty pipelines). Rates per SKU: cost_supply, cost_install, supply_markup, install_markup (R-c); the eight derived items (sheet rows 81-86, 89, 91) carry markups only (R-f). Pricing rule for a later slice: BoQ = ROUNDUP(cost x (1 + markup), 0), per side. Slice 1c (2026-09-21): attributes_from_spec -- item_name and item_detail are the source of truth; every other attribute is READ from them by services/boq_rate_master/spec_reader.py (never hand-edited, never a CSV column). Rows 89 and 91 store cost_install 0 (S-d).

Slice 2 (2026-09-22, owner P-a / P-b): ALWAYS priced from a vendor quotation -- nothing to extract, nothing to price, NO items. Message-only config: helper_message is what the rate helper panel and the calculator show instead of 'coming soon'; pending_label marks every empty / zero rate cell of a row in this category until a non-zero rate is typed. Empty attribute_definitions + empty pipelines keep it out of extraction and pricing (config_is_eligible / isEligibleConfig both False); it is fetched by the rate helper but NOT listed on the Rate Master page (registry holds_items: false).
